protocol.candidates: Exactly twelve per-layer/offset MBRs plus existing Global6 MBR, duplicate removal; no GT oracle online.
protocol.base: Current Global6 paired hull and original physical tIoU MBR; source native224 overall reference.
protocol.ambiguity: Original best expected tIoU<.5 OR mean tIoU of12 view MBRs against incumbent<.5. Fixed without labels; not GT wrongness.
protocol.evidence: Hidden change empirical rank at two ends times positive target-ROI-enrichment entry/exit contrasts. Continuous physical-time weighted window means, each window min(interval_length/4,1 second). Scores in[0,1].
protocol.prior: Score=original expected tIoU(candidate)+lambda*evidence. lambda=.05/.10 only, no further sweep; same weight and candidate budget for hidden-only and permuted.
protocol.gate: Gated main arms retain exactly incumbent on nonambiguous inputs. One ungated .05 diagnostic detects whether gate blocks useful corrections.
protocol.exposure: All cohorts historically exposed. HC64 development selects at most one of two fixed strengths; HC32/Vid32 frozen parent-isolated development rechecks, not pristine tests.
protocol.selection: Choose best HC64 joint tIoU among .05/.10 passing: delta_t>=.0025,delta_full_v>0,delta_fixed_space_v>0,delta_t versus both matched hidden/permuted>0; no more than2 additional Source-relative severe v drops. If no passing strength, no new method.
protocol.recheck: If HC64 selects: both HC32/Vid32 delta_t>0 anddelta_full_v>=0, at most2 additional Source-relative severe v drops/domain; equal-domain stratified-bootstrap pooled delta_t lower95>0 and full_v lower95>-.005. No tuning on recheck.
protocol.evaluation: Every query retained; GT tIoU<.5/.7 wrong subsets only offline, crossed with label-free ambiguity. Report rescued/harmed correct cases, start/end errors, full and same-spatial vIoU, signed severe losses, candidate oracle as diagnostic only.
protocol.cost: one CPU thread nice15; existing signals and actual geometry/posteriors only; zero GPU/RGB/encoder/decoder/head/expert/update. Candidate construction, rerank, DP and cache IO separately timed. Not standalone end-to-end.
